service_budget.formula: min(cap, max(fixed base, (unpaid debt bits + 8 * pending framed bytes) / drain_ms))
service_budget.fixed_base: initial encoder ceiling plus nominal source framing rate; unchanged by later targets
service_budget.interpretation: configured local service allowance, not a measured capacity or wire-rate guarantee
service_budget.objective: rolling work/rate drainage objective including the final unit's debt, assuming the chosen rate stayed fixed and no new work arrived; not a completion or per-frame deadline guarantee
service_budget.updates: after atomic enqueue, complete expiry chain, or dispatch with full debt charge; held between mutations

immediate_live.scope: receiver delivery rate is not unused link capacity; healthy reports permit probes; source load includes framing, IDRs and admission-rejected units; all clocks and fixed-delay feedback are virtual

immediate_live.note: immediate dispatch; no local queue or pacing budget

target_paced_live.note: whole access-unit dispatch attempts incur framed-bit debt regardless of downstream admission; expiry and dependency suppression affect only unsent units; all age is measured from original capture time; idle credit is not accumulated; expiry wins readiness ties within 1e-9 ms at its actual timestamp, never early

fixed_service_live.note: whole access-unit dispatch attempts incur framed-bit debt regardless of downstream admission; expiry and dependency suppression affect only unsent units; all age is measured from original capture time; idle credit is not accumulated; expiry wins readiness ties within 1e-9 ms at its actual timestamp, never early

service.formula: work_bits = debt_bits + 8 * pending_wire_bytes; service_kbps = min(cap_kbps, max(base_kbps, work_bits / drain_ms)); with queue_boost disabled service_kbps = base_kbps
service.note: base and cap are fixed from initial target plus nominal framing, not capacity estimates; rate refreshes only after complete enqueue, expiry or dispatch mutations; no refresh at observation endpoints, reports or target-only changes; the rolling work horizon includes the last unit's post-dispatch debt and is not a dispatch-wait or end-to-end latency guarantee; tail mutations still refresh service

queue_service_live.note: whole access-unit dispatch attempts incur framed-bit debt regardless of downstream admission; expiry and dependency suppression affect only unsent units; all age is measured from original capture time; idle credit is not accumulated; expiry wins readiness ties within 1e-9 ms at its actual timestamp, never early

scope.clock: real local H.264; virtual capture, dispatch, media, feedback and playout clocks
scope.causality: service sees initial configuration, generated units, unpaid debt, pending bytes and time; no future capacity, downstream admission, loss or in-flight occupancy input
scope.pacing: complete access-unit attempts incur full framed-bit debt even on downstream rejection; no idle credit, refunds, packet fragmentation or per-instant rate guarantee
scope.queue: same unsent count/age/dependency policy and bounded local repairs in all three paced live arms
scope.events: settle elapsed debt at old service rate; mutate local queue; choose new service; ordinary advance/report calls and encoder target changes do not refresh independent service
scope.age: all queue and presentation ages retain original capture times and full source horizon
scope.tail: watchdog and source actions stop at final capture; local service may update on actual tail dispatch/expiry mutations; no additional encoder actions
scope.attribution: target-paced versus fixed service changes rate coupling; fixed versus queue service measures the complete feedback-coupled boost policy; exact-source replay measures combined sender handling conditioned on the queue-service source
scope.paired_link: same parameters/seed; changed admission can shift jitter/loss draws; zero jitter and zero random loss remove this pairing ambiguity
scope.limits: bounded synthetic source, conservative closed-GOP dependencies, ideal reverse feedback; service cap is not known available bandwidth; no physical network/display or Colab allocation
